svg.text: Takes them out of the waiting list and opens their

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: visit. The wait clock stops.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Vitals, examination, diagnosis against a coded

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: catalogue. Allergies are visible throughout, not on

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a tab.

ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Prescribe

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: /encounters/[id]

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drug, dose, frequency, duration. The allergy and

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: interaction check runs as the drug is chosen, not on

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: save.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sign and finalise

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Needs a medical registration number on file. The

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: prescription becomes a legal document and stops

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: being editable.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It reaches the counter

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace

svg.text: automatic

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A finalised prescription appears in the pharmacy

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: queue — only if the clinic has that module.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Guards, branches and the things that refuse

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No registration number, no signature

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The gate is stated when the consultation opens rather than at the moment of signing, so nobody writes a whole prescription and then discovers they

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cannot finish it. A clinic administrator adds the number under Staff and roles.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: An emergency arrives at the top of the queue, marked

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A red rail, a red position number and the phone number of whoever brought them in on the row. It sorts on the FLAG, not on manual position, so

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: reordering the queue cannot push somebody who was carried in below a routine follow-up. From here it is an ordinary visit: same consultation, same

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: prescription, same bill.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Finalising is deliberately irreversible

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Corrections go through an amendment, which adds an addendum and leaves the original standing. A clinical record that can be edited after the fact is

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: not a record.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Private notes are private from the administrator too

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: They are not part of the clinical record, are not visible to administrators, and never print.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lab results return to the person who ordered them

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Unread results stay visible rather than ageing out of a list, because the failure mode is a result nobody opens.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What this role cannot do, at the server

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Change staff or roles, take a payment, alter stock, or reach the de-identified analytics layer beyond reading it.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Prescribing is the privilege; running the practice is a different role.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, monospace
